image_description: A close-up view of a bakery storefront window. The top shelf is densely packed with round, flour-dusted bread loaves. Below, through the glass, two staff members in white uniforms and hats are visible working behind a counter. Lower shelves display various pastries and baked goods. A small sign stands on the lower glass ledge. The lighting is warm and artificial, reflecting off the glass.

The figure on the left has arms that appear to merge with the white uniform or the counter surface. Hand structures are indistinct and lack clear finger definition, typical of AI generation struggles with complex poses.

The geometry of the background counters and shelves becomes slightly warped and inconsistent with linear perspective, particularly on the right side where objects seem to float or tilt unnaturally.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the scene is correctly classified as a bakery and not a generic kitchen or grocery store.
To assess the overall realism, lighting consistency, and detect subtle texture artifacts in the bread and glass reflections.
To rigorously evaluate the legibility of the small sign in the foreground and any background text, which are common failure points.
To check for merging boundaries between the staff's white uniforms and the background/counter, and to ensure individual bread loaves are distinct entities.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of human figures (hands/arms) behind the counter.
Legibility and coherence of text on the foreground sign.
Texture realism of flour-dusted bread vs. AI-smoothed surfaces.
Geometric consistency of shelving and background elements.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'human' figures in the background. AI often generates 'melting' limbs when subjects are wearing white uniforms against light backgrounds. Verify if the hands are structurally sound or if they merge into the counter. Also, scrutinize the text on the small stand-up sign; it is highly likely to be gibberish. Do not let the high-quality appearance of the bread loaves mask potential structural issues with the people or text.
